start.title: After the Walls Fell
start.text:
Jericho lies in dust at your feet.
The Lord forbade all spoils.

choices.text: Take some gold for the camp
choices.feedback: His command was absolute.

choices.text: Devote everything to the Lord
choices.feedback: You honor the ban He set.

choices.text: Let each man keep a token
choices.feedback: One stolen thread defiles all.

take_consequence.title: Nothing Is Yours
take_consequence.text:
What is devoted belongs to Him.
Not one shekel for your hand.

choices.text: Devote everything to the Lord
choices.feedback: You drop the gold from your fingers.

token_consequence.title: No Exceptions
token_consequence.text:
A small theft poisons the whole.
The ban allows no token.

choices.text: Devote everything to the Lord
choices.feedback: You command the ranks to leave it.

warn_camp.title: A Whisper in the Camp
warn_camp.text:
Yet one man bends in his tent.
A cloak. Silver. Buried gold.

choices.text: Ignore the rumor of theft
choices.feedback: Hidden sin will not stay hidden.

choices.text: Send scouts ahead to small Ai
choices.feedback: You move without seeking Him.

choices.text: Seek the Lord before the next step
choices.feedback: You bow first, march later.

ignore_consequence.title: Sin Cannot Hide
ignore_consequence.text:
What is buried still defiles.
The camp is not as it seems.

choices.text: Seek the Lord before the next step
choices.feedback: You turn toward the tent of meeting.

ai_battle.title: The Hill of Ai
ai_battle.text:
Three thousand men climb proud.
Thirty-six fall. The rest flee.

choices.text: Blame the soldiers' weakness
choices.feedback: The fault is deeper than swords.

choices.text: Tear your robe before the ark
choices.feedback: You fall on your face till evening.

choices.text: Order an immediate counter-attack
choices.feedback: He has withdrawn His hand. Wait.

blame_consequence.title: Look Higher
blame_consequence.text:
Their arms did not fail today.
Something among you has.

choices.text: Tear your robe before the ark
choices.feedback: You sink to the dust in mourning.

counter_consequence.title: Not Without Him
counter_consequence.text:
You charge again, but no breath of victory comes.
Turn back.

choices.text: Tear your robe before the ark
choices.feedback: You lay down arms and cry out.

seek_lord.title: Before the Battle
seek_lord.text:
He answers: "Israel has sinned."
Defeat already waits at Ai.

choices.text: Tear your robe before the ark
choices.feedback: You fall on your face in grief.

joshua_grief.title: Why, O Lord?
joshua_grief.text:
He answers: rise, sin is in the camp.
It must be brought to light.

choices.text: Hush the matter to keep peace
choices.feedback: Silence will cost more lives.

choices.text: Gather the tribes for inquiry
choices.feedback: You call every banner forward.

hush_consequence.title: Truth Must Stand
hush_consequence.text:
He will not march beside hidden sin.
Bring it into the day.

choices.text: Gather the tribes for inquiry
choices.feedback: You summon the elders at dawn.

investigation.title: Tribe by Tribe
investigation.text:
Lots are cast. Judah is taken.
Then the clan. Then the man.

choices.text: Stop before the name is spoken
choices.feedback: His justice cannot be halted now.

choices.text: Press on until truth is named
choices.feedback: The lot falls on Achan.

stop_consequence.title: Justice Will Out
stop_consequence.text:
What He has begun, He finishes.
Let truth speak its full word.

choices.text: Press on until truth is named
choices.feedback: You nod to the priests to continue.

achan_revealed.title: "My Son, Confess"
achan_revealed.text:
Achan speaks: a cloak, silver, gold.
Buried beneath his tent floor.

choices.text: Excuse him, the loss was small
choices.feedback: Sin is never small to a holy God.

choices.text: Carry out the Lord's judgment
choices.feedback: Israel walks to the Valley of Achor.

choices.text: Hide the items and move on
choices.feedback: Concealment will only spread the rot.

excuse_consequence.title: The Whole Camp Bears It
excuse_consequence.text:
Mercy without justice keeps the curse.
The Lord's word must stand.

choices.text: Carry out the Lord's judgment
choices.feedback: You give the solemn order.

hide_consequence.title: No More Hiding
hide_consequence.text:
Hidden sin already cost lives.
It cannot be buried again.

choices.text: Carry out the Lord's judgment
choices.feedback: You step into the light of obedience.

ending_obedient.title: The Valley of Achor
ending_obedient.text:
The camp is cleansed. Stones rise as a witness.
The Lord turns from His anger.
